significance: The Malleus Maleficarum ('Hammer of Witches') by Dominican Inquisitor Heinrich Kramer synthesized the composite witch stereotype combining maleficium, demonic pact, and sabbath attendance into a single prosecutorial category, providing the theological, natural-philosophical, and procedural framework that would define witch prosecution in German-speaking territories for the next century and a half.
source_method: Published primary source; modern critical edition Christopher Mackay (Cambridge University Press, 2009)
